objective: Hand off a fail-closed one-shot CPU recompute implementation for the suspected M505 false kill; no production recompute or EDA/GPU/RTL action has been taken by the author.

implementation.single_frozen_row_ledger: H67 ep35, 10 samples x 4 bottleneck Conv3x3 x 432 partitions x 3000 rows

cycle_grains.sample_major: continuous task-order pipeline over all four operators plus one 96000-cycle sample commit
cycle_grains.operator_isolated: pipeline restart and no commit for every sample/operator slice; explicitly non-summable

implementation.capacity: M468/M473 logical and macro-rounded items are replayed; M505 replaces 9216 B nominal scratch rounding with nine 128x128-bit 1RW macros = 18432 B, adds a 1152-B rounded liveness bitmap, and must reproduce 213376 B with 32384 B margin under 240 KiB.
implementation.traffic: Weight, source, descriptor capture/search/scan, parent read/write, DMA command, and commit ledgers are emitted separately. Parent traffic is scaled to all eight output blocks and remains logical access traffic, not energy.
implementation.conservation: Arithmetic issue=residual nnz+exact-parent issue; parent reads+forwards=edges; writes+allowed elisions=active-row completions; trace rows and commit vectors are frozen.

fail_closed_runner.resource_floor: 64 GiB commit headroom, 128 GiB MemAvailable, 32 GiB SwapFree, clean user-slice OOM counters

review_focus: Prove M468 strong-zero and M473 bit use the same row64/banks8/128B-per-cycle coordinate and that the M473 concurrent-1R1W point is diagnostic only.
Check that sample-major cycles are reconstructed from task arrays and not from summed operator-isolated slices.
Check dead-only and combined read/write/forward/elision conservation and the sealed prior-M505 operator recurrence cross-check.
Check all memory obligations, including response queue, liveness metadata, descriptor directory, and ping-pong ownership, are present in capacity or explicitly classified as standard-cell area.
Check no CPU result is described as RTL, physical PPA, energy, full-network speedup, system speedup, or DATE headline.
